R1_minus_BRAY.statement: the counterfactual performs worse than the box-level filter

B-RAY_oracle_reference.note: B-RAY oracle (context only, GT used offline): drop every KNOWN final Y+ box (>= 3 receiver rays, not the receiver's own box) with no GT match at BEV IoU >= 0.5. The attacker-unit oracles (oracle_attacker, vis_oracle_attacker) gate sender units, not final boxes; they are NOT upper bounds for B-RAY.
